When Offset went on instagram live at 5am in the morning to beg Cardi B for some top 🤣😭

This will never not be funny 🤣

Cardi B and Offset are two highly influential American rappers who rose to massive mainstream success in the late 2010s.

Cardi B, born Belcalis Almánzar in New York City, first gained popularity as a viral social media personality and reality TV star on *Love & Hip Hop: New York*. She broke into global stardom with her smash hit single “Bodak Yellow” and her critically acclaimed, Grammy-winning debut album *Invasion of Privacy*.

Offset, born Kiari Cephus in Georgia, became famous as a member of the hip-hop trio Migos, known for major hits like “Bad and Boujee”. Alongside his work with Migos, he launched a successful solo career with albums like *Father of 4* and *SET IT OFF*.

The two began dating in 2017, collaborating on songs like “Lick” and “Clout,” and married later that year. Over the course of their high-profile relationship, they became one of hip-hop’s most prominent power couples and had three children together. Their relationship was frequently in the media spotlight, and after several breakups and reconciliations over the years, Cardi B filed for divorce.
